script.title: Temple of the Evening Bell
script.description: A Japanese Buddhist precinct with a sweeping irimoya worship hall, a golden altar visible through its entrance, a three-storey pagoda crowned by a nine-ring sorin, and an open bell pavilion with a suspended bell and wooden striker. Shoji screens, timber brackets, stone steps and moss-grown lanterns complete the separate connected temple buildings.
